title: skill-evals project (.skill-evals.yaml)
description: Where a project keeps its evals, harnesses, libraries and fixtures. Paths are relative to this file. Create one with `skill-evals init`.

harnesses.description: Folder of harnesses (<name>/ with sbxenv.yaml and harness.yaml) and the shared base.sbxenv.yaml.

scorers.description: Optional Python package with extra scorers: its __init__.py defines REGISTRY, a dict of name to scorer factory.

runs.description: Where run folders and reports go (default .skill-evals/runs).

mlflow.description: Where the managed MLflow server keeps its database and artifacts (default .skill-evals/mlflow).
